label: AVR ISP 6 Pin
description: AVR ISP 6 Pin This is the reduced ISP connector for AVR programming. Common on Arduino. This footprint will take up less PCB space and can be used with a 10-pin to 6-pin adapter such as SKU: BOB-08508
